contracts.name: Isolation First
contracts.rule: Complex motion/VFX/3D/audio-transition components MUST be testable independently of the full composition.

contracts.name: Component Evidence
contracts.rule: Component proof MUST include source revision, parameters, representative frames or motion proof, measurements and output digest.

contracts.name: Composition Admission
contracts.rule: Only explicitly accepted component revisions MAY be automatically reused in a composition plan.

contracts.name: Affected Descendants Only
contracts.rule: A component revision MUST invalidate only provably dependent descendants.

contracts.name: No New Authority
contracts.rule: The Component Lab is a workspace projection and MUST NOT become a render, timeline, asset or evidence authority.
